description: Opt-in fork continuation and isolation acceptance test.

cases.domain: POSIX fork, process memory, inherited descriptors and waitpid
cases.negative_control: The child must see pre-fork stack, global and heap values after the parent writes, and the parent must retain its own values after the child writes. A blocked child must remain unreaped under WNOHANG. Its reported PID must match, it must exit 37, and the second wait must fail with ECHILD.
cases.evidence_level: Exact native/guest stdout, stderr and exit status.
